answer: The wander is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the raven. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. Reaching the signal of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, weighted by independent path length, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work.
